uit te zullen schenken

glosses: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see pour, out.
To serve a drink into a cup or glass.

examples.text: I poured out three beers for my guests.

glosses: To distribute or spread (something), as if it were a liquid.

examples.text: […] therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

glosses: To leave a place quickly, and in large numbers.

examples.text: The rats came pouring out of every possible opening in the burning warehouse.

glosses: To talk volubly and deeply. Usually implies telling the truth.

examples.text: She started crying, and she poured out the whole story, right from the beginning.

glosses: Derramar o vaciar líquidos, y también cosas menudas; como sal, harina, etc.
Inclinar una vasija o volverla boca abajo para vaciar su contenido.
Tratándose de máximas, especies, conceptos, etc., decirlos con determinado objeto, y por lo común con fin siniestro.
Dicho de un líquido: Fluir por una pendiente.
Dicho de un curso de agua: Desembocar en otro.
